name: com.bgpkit/bgpkit-api
title: BGPKIT API
description: Search public BGP MRT archives by time window and collector, and look up any IP address or ASN.

ts_start.description: Start timestamp for data collection period. Accepts ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-01T00:00:00Z') or Unix timestamp. Use to find data from a specific date onwards for historical analysis.

ts_end.description: End timestamp for data collection period. Same format as ts_start. Combine with ts_start to define a specific time window for targeted BGP event analysis or research.

collector_id.description: Specific route collector identifier. Examples: 'route-views.linx' (RouteViews LINX), 'rrc01' (Amsterdam).

project.description: BGP data collection project. Options: 'routeviews' (University of Oregon RouteViews project) or 'riperis' (RIPE NCC Routing Information Service). Each has different collector locations and methodologies.

data_type.description: Type of BGP data to retrieve. 'rib' = Routing Information Base (periodic full routing table snapshots, typically every 2-8 hours, ideal for network topology analysis). 'updates' = real-time BGP routing updates (announcements/withdrawals, ideal for studying routing dynamics and outages).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1). Use for navigating large datasets when searching broad time periods or popular collectors.

page_size.description: Results per page. Range: 1-1000, default: 100. Use larger values (500-1000) for bulk data discovery, smaller values (10-50) for quick exploration.

collector_id.description: Target specific route collector for latest data. Examples: 'route-views.linx', 'rrc01'. Omit to get latest files from all collectors.

data_type.description: Type of latest BGP data needed. 'rib' returns most recent routing table snapshots (best for current network topology analysis), 'updates' returns latest real-time routing changes (best for monitoring recent network events). Omit to get both types.

collector_id.description: Target route collector to analyze peer relationships. Examples: 'route-views.linx', 'rrc01'

asn.description: Filter for specific Autonomous System Number to see route collectors peers from a specific network

active.description: Filter for active collectors only (not deactivated)

ip.description: IP address to analyze (IPv4 or IPv6 format). Examples: '8.8.8.8' (Google DNS), '2001:4860:4860::8888' (Google IPv6 DNS), '1.1.1.1' (Cloudflare DNS). Returns geolocation, ASN ownership, BGP prefix, and RPKI validation status - essential for security analysis, geoblocking, network forensics, and traffic analytics.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number to analyze (1-4294967295). Examples: 15169 (Google), 7922 (Comcast), 13335 (Cloudflare), 32934 (Facebook). Returns organization details, network size metrics (customer cone, prefixes, ASN relationships), geographic presence, hegemony scores, and connectivity patterns - crucial for competitive intelligence, peering analysis, and Internet topology research. Omit to browse or filter all ASNs.

country.description: Filter ASNs by country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., 'US', 'DE', 'JP'). Useful for finding all autonomous systems registered in a specific country.

search.description: Search ASNs by name or organization (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'google', 'comcast', 'cloudflare'. Useful for finding ASNs when you don't know the exact number.

page.description: Page number for paginated results when browsing all ASNs or filtering by country/search. Starts from 0.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 10000). Default: 100. Use for pagination when browsing large result sets.

asns.description: Array of ASN numbers to analyze (max 10,000 per request). Examples: [15169, 7922, 13335]. More efficient than individual lookups for analyzing multiple networks simultaneously.

asn.description: Filter by Autonomous System Number. Examples: 174 (Cogent), 3356 (Level3), 1299 (Arelion). Returns all communities defined by this AS.

value.description: Specific community value to lookup (e.g., '174:21000' or '174:20xxx'). Supports wildcard patterns. Returns exact and wildcard range matches.

description.description: Filter by description text (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'blackhole', 'localpref', 'prepend'. Useful for finding communities with specific functions.

as_name.description: Filter by AS organization name (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'Cogent', 'Level3', 'NTT'. Useful when you don't know the exact ASN.

country.description: Filter by country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., 'US', 'DE', 'JP'). Returns communities from ASNs in the specified country.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (0-indexed, default: 0). Use for browsing large result sets.

page_size.description: Results per page (default: 10, max: 1000). Use smaller values (10-50) for quick lookups, larger values (100-500) for bulk analysis.
